$comment: Decision Log 2, X49): the ONLY statement of the held-out texture cells. Each scene below is held
out on each profile below, six cells per scale, twelve in all. The canonical holdout has no
fine-pitch cell, so these probe cells are the fine periods' referees: a thin and a thick span,
both poses and a tint at the fine pitches, plus one coarse inactive cell.
Four consumers read this file and nothing else: the planner (referees/plan.py: the pre-gate
probe whitelist excludes them, the exposure whitelist adds them), the fit loader (cuts/bed.py
refuses a candidate or pre-fit bed carrying one), the gate (bed.py and `plan.py check-stage`
refuse a stage holding one before the exposure) and the exposure (the planner's second list,
read once). The cross-gate holdout ledger's read records this file's SHA-256 as witness-only
metadata (`configuration.py record --referees`). Canonical membership in scenes.json is
untouched: every scene below stays a probe scene there.
